data.name: Badiah
data.gender_notes: Badiah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Badiah refers to the initial stage of a journey, a new beginning, or the first steps towards a significant change. It is derived from the Arabic root 'b-d-y', which connotes the idea of 'going forward' or 'moving on'. The name Badiah carries the meaning “A beginning, initiation, or start” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Badiah usually hope their child will grow to embody a beginning, initiation, or start and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of hope, renewal, and the courage to begin a new chapter in life.
data.etymology: Badiah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A beginning, initiation, or start.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Badiah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: بديعة
in_arabic.meaning: بديعة تعني الجديدة والمبتكرة والمتميزة في المعنى والدلالة
in_arabic.long_meaning: بديعة هي اسم علم مؤنث، مشتق من الفعل بدع، والذي يعني الإنشاء أو الخلق. وبديعة تعني أيضًا الابتكار والإبداع. في اللغة العربية، تحمل هذه الكلمة معاني الابتكار والتميز والإبداع. وفي السياق الإسلامي، يمكن أن يُنظر إلى الاسم على أنه تعبير عن قدرة الله تعالى على خلق كل شيء جديد وفريد.

in_urdu.name: بدیعہ
in_urdu.meaning: بدیعہ کا مطلب ہے نئی، منفرد اور خاص
in_urdu.long_meaning: بدیعہ ایک علم اسم ہے، جو بدع فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے تخلیق یا پیدا کرنا۔ اردو میں، یہ لفظ تخلیق، اختراع اور انفرادیت کے معنی رکھتا ہے۔ اسلامی سیاق و سباق میں، اس نام کو اللہ تعالی کی ہر چیز کو نئی اور منفرد بنانے کی صلاحیت کے اظہار کے طور پر دیکھا جا سکتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمان روایت میں، یہ نام ایک خوبصورت اور معنی خیز انتخاب کے طور پر سمجھا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बदीहा
in_hindi.meaning: बदीहा का अर्थ है नई, अनोखी और विशेष
in_hindi.long_meaning: बदीहा एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है, जो अरबी भाषा के बदع क्रिया से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है बनाना या पैदा करना। हिंदी में, यह शब्द सृजन, नवाचार और विशिष्टता के अर्थ रखता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण विकल्प के रूप में देखा जाता है। यह नाम नवाचार और सृजन की भावना को दर्शाता है।

in_pashto.name: بديعه
in_pashto.meaning: بديعه د نوي، ځانګړې او خاص معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: بديعه د ښځينو یو نوم دی، چې د بدع فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چې د جوړولو یا پیداکولو معنی لري. پښتو کې، دا کلمه د جوړښت، اختراع او ځانګړتیا معنی لري. د افغان او پښتني دودیزو ارزښتونو له مخې، دا نوم د الله تعالی د قدرت څرګندونه ده چې هر څه نوې او ځانګړې کړي.

in_english.name: Badiah
in_english.meaning: Means new, unique, and special in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: Badiah is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic verb 'badac', which means to create or bring into existence. In Arabic, the name Badiah conveys meanings of innovation, uniqueness, and excellence. In Islamic context, the name may reflect the idea of God's power to create all things new and original. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing creativity, distinctiveness, and spiritual significance. The name Badiah is associated with positive personality traits such as being innovative, independent, and charismatic.

data.cultural_impact: Badiah holds a special significance in Islamic culture, as it represents the first step towards embracing a new and rewarding path. In the religious milieu, Badiah is used to narrate the stories of Prophets and their early struggle, the lives of pious scholars, and the journey of many a believer towards spiritual growth. Moreover, it serves as a reminder that every person's life is at the beginning of a new journey and the choices they make in the initial stages often shape their future.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, Badiah is seen as a time of keen observation, taking the first firm steps towards transformation. It offers an opportunity to rid oneself of past sins and mistakes and make a genuine pledge to adhere to righteousness and guidance from Allah. This period holds great importance and rewards, as the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "There is a reward for every step (taken by a person) and it is granted to him before he takes the next step." This emphasis highlights the spiritual significance of Badiah as a chance to seek forgiveness for past transgressions, cultivate good manners, and focus on self-improvement, paving the way for a spiritually enriching journey.
